title: Moduli of smoothness and growth of the Laguerre transform: two-sided estimates
summary: We study weighted coefficient estimates for the Laguerre transform in terms of moduli of smoothness generated by the Laguerre translation. For every integer $r\ge1$ and $1\le p\le2$, a weighted $\ell^{p'}$ norm of $\min\{1,nt\}^{r}\widehat f_α(n)$ is bounded by the modulus of order $r$; for $2\le p\le\infty$ the reverse direction holds on the same weighted sequence scale. At $p=2$ these estimates yield a two-sided equivalence, and testing individual Laguerre polynomials proves optimality of the multiplier weight up to constants.
